SELECT sum(a.recharge_money) total_recharge FROM ( SELECT p.recharge_acount member_id, p.money recharge_money FROM pay_agent_recharge_record p
and p.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and p.create_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT m.member_id, m.recharge_money FROM member_recharge_log m WHERE m.status = '3'
and m.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and m.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT u.member_id, u.recharge_money FROM pay_usdt_recharge u where u.status = '3'
and u.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and u.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL select j.member_id, j.money recharge_money from member_pay_jour j where j.status = '1'
and j.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and j.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
) as a left join member_info as mi on mi.id = a.member_id where mi.inviter_code = #{channelCode}

select sum(withdraw_money) as total_withdrawal from member_withdraw_log where status in (3, 6)
and update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and member_id in (SELECT id from member_info where inviter_code = #{channelCode})

SELECT ifnull(count(distinct a.member_id), 0) total_recharge FROM (select DISTINCT member_id from member_recharge_log where `first` = '1' and `status` = '3' and member_id in (select id from member_info where inviter_code = #{channelCode}) and update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') UNION ALL select DISTINCT member_id from member_pay_jour where `first` = '1' and `status` = '1' and member_id in (select id from member_info where inviter_code = #{channelCode}) and update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) a

SELECT ifnull(count( distinct a.member_id), 0) FROM ( SELECT distinct p.recharge_acount member_id FROM pay_agent_recharge_record p
and p.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and p.create_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT distinct m.member_id FROM member_recharge_log m WHERE m.status = '3'
and m.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and m.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT distinct u.member_id FROM pay_usdt_recharge u where u.status = '3'
and u.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and u.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL select j.member_id from member_pay_jour j where j.status = '1'
and j.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and j.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
) as a left join member_info as mi on mi.id = a.member_id where mi.inviter_code = #{channelCode}

select ifnull(sum(withdraw_money),0) withdraw_money from member_withdraw_log
`status` in (3, 6)
and update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and member_id in (select id from member_info where inviter_code = #{req.channelCode})
